fields.name: cart
fields.description: Return information about the specified shopping cart.

args.name: cart_id
args.description: The unique ID of the cart to query.

fields.name: countries
fields.description: The countries query provides information for all countries.

fields.name: products
fields.description: Search for products that match the criteria specified in the `search` and `filter` attributes.

args.name: search
args.description: One or more keywords to use in a full-text search.

args.name: filter
args.description: The product attributes to search for and return.

args.name: pageSize
args.description: The maximum number of results to return at once. The default value is 20.

args.name: currentPage
args.description: The page of results to return. The default value is 1.

args.name: sort
args.description: Specifies which attributes to sort on, and whether to return the results in ascending or descending order.

fields.name: createEmptyCart
fields.description: Create an empty shopping cart for a guest or logged in user

args.name: input
args.description: An optional input object that assigns the specified ID to the cart.

fields.deprecationReason: Use `Mutation.createGuestCart` or `Query.customerCart` for logged in customer
